query: fold tasks on rig-grade-swarm, there are too many open tasks
expected_behavior: runs agentihooks ledger --slug rig-grade-swarm --as NAME fold candidates before writing any plan
writes plan.json in a folder made by agentihooks scratch new, not in /tmp or the repository
runs fold check on the plan until it prints ok true before asking the operator

expected_behavior: drops the oversized corpus task from the group instead of folding it into one giant pull request
judges the group from task descriptions and territories, not titles alone
keeps one seam per remaining task in the plan, the lead first

fixes the plan and reruns fold check when it exits 2
reports groups made, tasks folded and tasks removed from the unfrozen count after fold apply
